lines: The day of the festival.
Uehara Shikanosuke, Koga Gennosuke, and I were walking through the somewhat crowded festival grounds.
Aishu Hebiko was there too, but since she had something else to do, we were just the three of us men for this trip.
It had been like that ever since we left the house. Koga Gennosuke seemed calm, but the curiosity in the depths of his eyes was barely hidden.
Judging by the stories of the world he came from, this place was separated by an era, so it was only natural that he would react this way.
By the way, we had toured the town during the day.
Because of our appearance, we had attracted quite a few stares from the people around us, but Koga Gennosuke had been sightseeing with great interest.
He seemed quite satisfied with it himself, so this would probably become a good memory for him.
By the time we had finished most of our sightseeing, the sun had set nicely, and we made our way to this festival venue.
Koga Gennosuke's distinctive outfit was blending in with the many yukata and festival costumes here, so it wasn't drawing any particular attention.
Looking at the food stalls, we walked toward the main venue in the center of the festival.
Koga Gennosuke
My, my, it is full of surprises. Everything I see with these eyes is vastly different from what I know.
Koga Gennosuke
Truly, I am even beginning to doubt that this land is Nihon.
Me
It is the real, genuine Japan. You can rest easy about that.
Me
However... even if it is Japan, it might be a different world from the one Koga Gennosuke lived in.
Uehara Shikanosuke
But hey, you could also think of it this way, right? The past of the world we live in was probably similar to your world, Koga Gennosuke?
Uehara Shikanosuke
Which means, if your world had progressed into the future, wouldn't it have ended up looking something like this place?
Koga Gennosuke
...I hope so. A land full of such charm is exactly the image of the future I wish for.
Koga Gennosuke spoke while gazing into the distance.
In order not to disappoint him, we must protect this world that Koga Gennosuke wished for.
As I walked with that resolve in mind, the rhythmic beating of drums began to reach my ears.
Uehara Shikanosuke
Oh! I can see it! Let's hurry!
Uehara Shikanosuke looked eager to run, so Koga Gennosuke and I shared a small laugh before heading toward the main venue.
Lanterns hung in a row from the watchtowers, casting a pale glow over the night sky and the crowd.
Uehara Shikanosuke and I both held our breath at the beauty of it.
Glancing at Koga Gennosuke beside me, I saw the festival lights reflected in his eyes; he seemed just as moved as we were.
Koga Gennosuke
What a beautiful sight... For a scene of such splendor, what words could I use to adorn it?
Koga Gennosuke
I am utterly unable to describe it fully. Ah... Oboro-sama.
Koga Gennosuke murmured, narrowing his eyes slightly as he voiced his feelings for Oboro.
Uehara Shikanosuke and I exchanged a glance, unsure how to address him.
Then, Koga Gennosuke's expression suddenly changed.
Koga Gennosuke
...No, forgive me. Have I offended you?
Koga Gennosuke
The time I spend with you is a joy to me as well. There is no falsehood in my words.
Me
Please don't worry about it. We understand.
Uehara Shikanosuke
Yeah, exactly! At a festival this lovely, of course you'd want to be with someone you like.
Koga Gennosuke
I am deeply ashamed.
Koga Gennosuke smiled gently.
Being in a place like this with other men only made me feel even more that it would be better with a woman. We understood that all too well.
In a way, it was a shared understanding only men could have, so perhaps coming alone with the guys was for the best.
Koga Gennosuke
By the way, Kotaro-san and Shikanosuke-san, have you not yet taken a wife?
Me
Taken a wife... you mean married, right? No, I haven't. I suppose it's still a bit early for that...
Uehara Shikanosuke
I haven't either. Besides, we don't even have girlfriends yet...! When am I ever going to get one?
Uehara Shikanosuke
...Ah, I remember. You're engaged to Oboro-san, right?
Koga Gennosuke
That is correct. The Koga and Iga clans have been at odds with one another for a long time.
Koga Gennosuke
Koga Man'yoku and Iga Habakiri. I am the grandson of the Koga head, and Oboro-san is the granddaughter of the Iga head.
Koga Gennosuke
Therefore, if we hold a wedding, it will serve as the foundation for the two families to join hands.
Koga Gennosuke
However... even if this marriage is for the sake of peace, I truly cherish Oboro-san with all my heart.
Koga Gennosuke
Even if we had not been born into ninja clans, I am certain I would have fallen for Oboro-san.
Gennosuke-san spoke with such passion that Kotaro and I were overwhelmed by the intensity of his affection.
Uehara Shikanosuke
Mmm, that's so nice... that kind of thing! It really feels like fate.
Me
Indeed, Gennosuke-san and Oboro-san look like a picture together. You two really suit each other.
Koga Gennosuke
This is... somewhat embarrassing. But I am sure a good match will come your way in time as well.
Me
I hope so, heh. Judging by the way you are telling this, did you meet Oboro-san solely for the engagement?
Koga Gennosuke
Precisely.
Me
What was it about Oboro-san that made you fall in love? You seem so deeply infatuated, so I am curious...
Koga Gennosuke
Hmm...
Gennosuke-san closed his eyes, seemingly taking his time to recall how he first met Oboro-san.
And the corners of his mouth gradually turned upward.
Koga Gennosuke
At the engagement meeting, Oboro-san was serving the tea. She was extremely nervous, so... she spilled the tea all over me.
Me
Huh!?
Koga Gennosuke
Oboro-san's face at that moment... I was captivated by the eyes that peeked through.
Me
That sounds like... love at first sight, right?
Koga Gennosuke
That is right.
Uehara Shikanosuke
Oh, that really is a fated encounter! Falling in love with someone's eyes. Man, I envy you...
So Gennosuke-san fell in love with Oboro-san's eyes.
Then what about Oboro-san's side of things?
From my perspective, I feel there is something in Gennosuke-san's eyes that makes it hard to look away once you see them.
Just as Gennosuke-san fell in love with Oboro-san, perhaps she fell for him in the same way.
As the three of us were chatting about romance, Shikanosuke's phone started ringing.
Uehara Shikanosuke
Oh! Sorry, I'll take this.
Uehara Shikanosuke
Hello? Hebiko? Ah, yeah. I think you're over there. Straight ahead... yes, toward the plaza.
Uehara Shikanosuke
There's a big tower, right? Behind that... Ah, is that it? Hey! Over here!!
I looked in the direction Shikanosuke was waving, and a figure that looked like Hebiko was approaching.
Aishu Hebiko
Found you~! There were so many people, I got a little lost. Sorry for keeping you waiting.
Uehara Shikanosuke
We just got here, so it's fine. We had some fun stories to tell ourselves anyway. Right, Fuuma!
Me
Yeah. It was a secret conversation between men.
Aishu Hebiko
What's that~? When you say it's a secret, I get curious. But, I have something more important right now!
Uehara Shikanosuke
Oh, so you're all set then!
Aishu Hebiko
Perfectly!
Koga Gennosuke
Hm? How did it go?
Hebiko and Shikanosuke grinned mischievously, while Gennosuke-san watched them with a puzzled expression.
I knew what was about to happen, so I tried my best to keep my face neutral, but the two of them clearly couldn't hold it in.
Eventually, Hebiko turned back toward the path she had come from and waved her hand in that direction.
Aishu Hebiko
Come on! Hurry up! If you keep hiding over there, you'll ruin the beauty of the moment, you know!
As Hebiko called out with a smile, Oboro-san peeked out from the shadow of the tower.
The one to react fastest to this was none other than Gennosuke-san.
Koga Gennosuke
Oboro...
Kirara
Gennosuke-sama...!
Oboro-san's face, which had looked anxious until just now, instantly brightened up the moment she saw Gennosuke-san's face.
And then, as if she couldn't contain her excitement, Oboro-san stumbled slightly before throwing herself into Gennosuke-san's arms.
Uehara Shikanosuke
Whoa~ this is hot...
Me
It seems it's still a bit early for us.
Aishu Hebiko
The surprise was a huge success.
The two of them held each other tightly, lost in thoughts of one another, completely oblivious to our presence.
Once they regained their composure, Koga Gennosuke turned to us and asked.
Koga Gennosuke
Kotaro... may I ask? Why is Oboro here?
Me
Actually, after I invited you to the festival, Oboro heard about it from someone else and said she wanted to go.
Me
But she had no idea you would be there? It just so happened that the place you both wanted to visit was exactly the same.
Koga Gennosuke
Is that truly the case, Oboro?
Kirara
Yes, I am ashamed to admit it... I never imagined things would turn out like this...
Oboro's face turned bright red.
Me
So, since we were going anyway, we secretly planned this together. I apologize for being so nosy.
Koga Gennosuke
No, I am deeply honored. Kotaro, Shikanosuke, Hebiko... I do not know how to repay you...
Uehara Shikanosuke
Hey, hey! We're not doing this for anything, right?
Aishu Hebiko
That's right. We did it because we wanted to, so seeing the two of you happy is all that matters!
Kirara
Hebiko, please accept my thanks as well. For pushing me to do this... I am truly grateful.
Aishu Hebiko
Oh, it's nothing! Hehe.
Koga Gennosuke remained close to Oboro, gazing into her eyes as they smiled at each other.
It seemed there was no room left for us to intrude.
It wasn't just me who felt that way; Shikanosuke and Hebiko seemed to think the same, nodding at each other before moving on to the next step.
Aishu Hebiko
Well... I think it's about time we left. You two young ones should enjoy the rest of it!
Uehara Shikanosuke
Hey, what's with that phrasing! Couldn't you think of something else? You sound really old.
Aishu Hebiko
Who's old? Mind your own business!
Koga Gennosuke
...Do you not mind?
Me
Of course not! That's exactly why we did this.
Koga Gennosuke
Kotaro...
Koga Gennosuke is a kind person.
So even after setting all this up, he would surely invite us to stay.
We had already accounted for that.
We joined up at this particular moment because a certain event was about to begin.
Me
Gennosuke, Kirameki. They say the taiko drums are about to start.
Koga Gennosuke
I see...
Me
The performance here seems quite authentic, so please enjoy it together. We will meet up again here once it is over.
Koga Gennosuke
...Ah, understood.
Me
Well then!
We hurriedly left the scene.
The silhouettes of Gennosuke and Kirameki gradually grew smaller.
It looked as though they had drawn closer to one another.
Soon, the sound of the taiko drums echoed through the air.
This melody, this scenery.
And the memories with Kirameki, Gennosuke would surely engrave them in his heart and carry them back to his distant homeland.
Thinking this with a sense of nostalgia, I stood alongside Shikanosuke and Hebiko, enjoying the lively festival.
Gentle morning light streamed in.
I woke up in my room.
Me
Hah...!
I jolted upright, pressing my hand lightly to my head.
Me
What was that... Did I have another strange dream? What was it about... Training... The festival... Hm?
Fragmentary, hazy memories.
It should have been a good dream, not a bad one, yet I could not clearly recall what it was about.
However, the word "festival" connected to something.
Me
Ah, that's right... I have training after this. After the library and training...
Me
Right, I was planning to go to the upcoming festival with Shikanosuke and Hebiko! Ah... That's what it was. I feel refreshed.
Interpreting it that way, I got out of bed and started getting ready.
Even though everything should have been a dream, it was a warm dream that felt somewhat real.
